events.title: EU-backed court convicts Kosovo ex-President of attempting to obstruct justice
events.description: A European Union-backed court has convicted Kosovo's former president, Hashim Thaci, of trying to obstruct justice and contempt of court

events.title: More than 200 people jailed over crackdown on illegal gold mining
events.description: A court in Guinea has sentenced 22 former officials and 202 miners to prison over illegal gold mining in the northeast

events.title: Pope forgives person who nailed him in the eye with a rosary in Peru
events.description: Pope Leo XIV has forgiven the person who threw a rosary at him before his final Mass in Peru and nailed him in the eye

events.title: Funding cuts raise risks of trafficking and exploitation for refugee children
events.description: Sharp reductions in humanitarian funding are putting refugees, particularly children, at increased risk of being trafficked, exploited or abused, while the systems that protect them are weakening.

events.title: Guterres calls for a legally binding instrument for ‘killer robots'
events.description: Talks began in Geneva on Monday to push for controls on lethal autonomous weapons systems that are often referred to as “killer robots”.

events.title: When the rains fail: Preparing for drought in Central America
events.description: Across Central America’s so-called Dry Corridor, farming families live at the mercy of the rains. In southwestern Honduras, Anastacio Martínez Gómez has spent most of his 73 years learning to work the land. But experience can only take him so far.

events.title: Housekeeper bringing towels to cruise cabin finds man with bloody hands, wife motionless on floor
events.description: Jason Leon Watford allegedly strangled his wife Susan Watford for minutes aboard the MSC Seascape, stopping only when exhausted, per an FBI affidavit.

events.title: MICHAEL RUIZ: Tyler Robinson defense wants testing on bullet fragments paused in assassination of Charlie Kirk
events.description: Tyler Robinson's lawyers want Utah ballistics testing paused as prosecutors push FBI virtual comparison microscopy on Charlie Kirk's autopsy fragments.

events.title: Major drug kingpin ‘The Kraken’ captured in California after yearslong hunt
events.description: Alleged Guatemalan cocaine kingpin Axel Montejo Saenz, known as "Kraken," was arrested in San Diego after agents seized over 5,500 kilograms of cocaine, authorities said.

events.title: Man legally named Captain America charged with murder after allegedly giving victim’s girlfriend chilling note
events.description: A man legally named Captain America allegedly gave a woman a note saying her boyfriend was dead and demanding her money. Police later found the boyfriend dead inside a home.

events.title: Florida substitute teacher arrested for allegedly sending explicit photos to teen student
events.description: Substitute teacher Mia Acevedo Gallardo was arrested after Hernando County detectives found explicit photos on a student's phone at Grace Education Academy.

events.title: California sheriff's deputy, special officer put on leave after 5-second conversation with ICE agents
events.description: Two California sheriff's department employees are on administrative leave after video captured a five-second ICE exchange outside a county jail.

events.title: South Carolina mother reveals troubling past of ex accused of burying their baby alive
events.description: Koah Sharp's mother speaks out after the 11-month-old was found buried alive in a dog crate during a massive law enforcement search in South Carolina.

events.title: Ivy League student slashed in neck, suspect accused was arrested just weeks before
events.description: NYPD says a Barnard College student was slashed behind her ear outside a Columbia University dorm as Earl Baker, a 44-year-old Brooklyn man, was arrested.

events.title: Pope Leo breaks silence on rosary striking his face in Peru, reveals details about cancer: 'Major surgery'
events.description: Pope Leo XIV says his lung cancer was found in a routine check-up with no symptoms, crediting prayer and doctors for his recovery before the Peru trip.

events.title: Kim Jong Un's daughter hits ski slopes in rare photos as North Korean dictator tours mountain resort
events.description: Kim Jong Un watched from a throne-like chair, cigarette in hand, as his daughter Kim Ju Ae skied down a snowy North Korean resort during a family outing.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Kim Jong Un's daughter hits ski slopes in rare photos as North Korean dictator tours mountain resort

events.title: Vance’s midterm blame game hits snag as Trump’s own Israel ambassador disputes key claim
events.description: Mike Huckabee rejects JD Vance's claim that Israel cost Republicans the midterms, blaming voter apathy and low evangelical turnout for the GOP defeat.

events.title: After UN peacekeeping mission ends, Morocco says Western Sahara dispute enters new phase
events.description: Western Sahara talks enter a new phase as a senior Sahrawi official says Morocco will implement its autonomy proposal even if the Polisario Front refuses to agree.

events.title: American basketball player’s Nigeria trip ends in arrest after officials spot him abandoning suspicious bags
events.description: Nigerian officials say an American basketball player abandoned two checked bags containing 75 pounds of cannabis before officers arrested him in a parking lot.

events.title: Pope Leo XIV hit in the face by flying rosary during farewell Mass in Peru, video shows
events.description: Pope Leo XIV was struck near the eye by a rosary tossed at his popemobile in Lima, Peru, video shows, but the pontiff continued the farewell Mass.

events.title: Mexico's cartel 'godfather' convicted in American DEA agent's murder dies at age 80
events.description: The Guadalajara cartel boss convicted in DEA agent Enrique "Kiki" Camarena's murder died at 80, decades after the killing triggered Operation Leyenda.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Mexico's cartel 'godfather' convicted in American DEA agent's murder dies at age 80
